2607.17269.title: An Explicit World Model Based on Data-First Ontology: DaoQL Multimodal Storage Validation and Counterfactual Reasoning Evaluation
2607.17269.paper_summary: Large language models encode world models implicitly in neural weights, which exposes four structural risks in high-precision domains such as medicine and finance: hallucination, frozen knowledge, poor explainability, and poor modifiability. This paper proposes data-first ontology: LLMs are treated as reasoning and language engines, while deterministic knowledge is moved into an explicit multimodal database, DaoQL. We formalize an explicit world model and show that, under rule independence, deterministic evaluation, and fixed conflict resolution, explicit models provide a sufficient condition for composable counterfactual decomposability; implicit models lack atomic read/delta semantics and therefore provide no comparable architectural guarantee. The implemented system focuses on DaoQL's verified storage layer and explicit Eval path, integrating graph, column, vector, and full-text engines within one process. KVCache graph nodes, expert hot updates, and the DaoQL-Agent runtime remain future work. On an embedded same-machine setup, DaoQL reports graph BFS at 1.20 ms, HNSW at 83.1 us, and a Fluent hybrid query at 105.8 us; these results indicate engineering potential but must be interpreted with deployment-shape differences from client-server systems. Exploratory measurements on LDBC SNB SF1 and ANN-Benchmarks further show 34/34 query coverage with interactive-class queries mostly in the sub-millisecond to millisecond range, but only 1.8 QPS overall due to long-tail BI/IC queries; ANN-Benchmarks reaches Recall@10 >= 99% at thousand-level QPS after a bridge-edge protection fix. In a five-domain counterfactual experiment (n = 1250), DaoQL+GPT-4o achieves 94% composable counterfactual decomposability, 49 percentage points above GPT-4o alone. The paper explicitly separates provable structure, preliminary empirical evidence, and architectural roadmap claims.
2607.17269.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在神經權重中隱式編碼世界模型，這在醫療和金融等高精度領域暴露出四個結構風險：幻覺、靜態知識、解釋性差和可修改性差。本文提出數據優先本體論：將大型語言模型視為推理和語言引擎，同時將確定性知識移入一個明確的多模態數據庫DaoQL。我們形式化了一個明確的世界模型，並顯示在規則獨立性、確定性評估和固定衝突解決的情況下，明確模型提供了可組合的反事實可分解性的充分條件；隱式模型缺乏原子讀取/增量語義，因此不提供可比的架構保證。實施的系統專注於DaoQL的驗證存儲層和明確的評估路徑，將圖形、列、向量和全文引擎整合在一個過程中。KVCache圖形節點、專家熱更新和DaoQL-Agent運行時仍然是未來的工作。在嵌入的同機設置中，DaoQL報告圖形BFS為1.20毫秒，HNSW為83.1微秒，流暢混合查詢為105.8微秒；這些結果顯示出工程潛力，但必須與客戶端-服務器系統的部署形狀差異一起解釋。對LDBC SNB SF1和ANN-Benchmarks的探索性測量進一步顯示34/34的查詢覆蓋率，交互類查詢大多在亞毫秒到毫秒範圍內，但由於長尾BI/IC查詢，整體僅為1.8 QPS；ANN-Benchmarks在進行橋邊保護修復後，達到Recall@10 >= 99%的千級QPS。在一個五領域的反事實實驗中（n = 1250），DaoQL+GPT-4o實現了94%的可組合反事實可分解性，比單獨的GPT-4o高出49個百分點。本文明確區分了可證明的結構、初步的實證證據和架構路線圖的主張。
